dbscan.pseudocode:
def dbscan(points, eps, min_pts):
    label = {p: None for p in points}  # None = 미방문
    c = 0
    for p in points:
        if label[p] is not None:
            continue
        nbrs = region_query(p, eps)  # 자기 자신 포함
        if len(nbrs) < min_pts:
            label[p] = NOISE  # 이후 경계점이 될 수 있음
            continue
        c += 1
        label[p] = c  # 핵심점 → 새 군집
        seeds = list(nbrs)
        while seeds:
            q = seeds.pop()
            if label[q] == NOISE:
                label[q] = c  # 잡음 → 경계점으로 편입
            if label[q] is not None:
                continue
            label[q] = c
            q_nbrs = region_query(q, eps)
            if len(q_nbrs) >= min_pts:  # q도 핵심점이면 확장
                seeds.extend(q_nbrs)
    return label
